tour.name: Zanzibar Private Nature Day: Red Colobus Monkeys in Jozani Forest, Mangroves & the Rock Restaurant

tour.overview:
Jozani Chwaka Bay National Park protects the last large area of indigenous forest on Zanzibar and is home to the Zanzibar red colobus, a monkey found nowhere else on Earth, with a tufted crown and a curious expression. A boardwalk winds through the neighbouring mangroves. On the south-east coast, women farm seaweed in the shallow lagoons, and the Rock restaurant stands on a rock reached on foot at low tide and by boat at high tide.

This private day shows Zanzibar's nature and coast with a licensed guide and a vehicle.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: about 7 hours
• Start and end: your hotel on Zanzibar
• Type: private tour with licensed guide, vehicle and driver
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy

WHAT YOU SEE
• Jozani Forest.
• The mangroves.
• A seaweed cooperative.
• The Rock.

WHY THIS WORKS
A private guide finds the colobus troops and links the forest, the coast and lunch at your pace.

WHO IT SUITS
Families, nature lovers and couples.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
For Stone Town and spices, choose our Stone Town and spice tour.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
Lunch at the Rock must be booked in advance; we arrange it. Keep a respectful distance from the monkeys and do not feed them.

days.name: Jozani Forest, the mangroves, a seaweed cooperative and lunch at the Rock
days.description:
What to expect: the nature and coast of southern Zanzibar, with a licensed guide, private vehicle, entrance and lunch.

Your guide collects you at about 9:00 and drives to Jozani Forest. A park guide leads you along trails among mahogany and palms to the troops of red colobus monkeys, which feed and play in the trees and on the ground, often only a few metres away. You also look for Sykes's monkeys and bush babies' nests. Across the road, a boardwalk leads through the mangroves, where crabs scuttle in the mud and your guide explains the importance of the mangroves for the coast.

At Paje, you visit a seaweed cooperative, where women grow seaweed in the lagoon and make soaps and oils, and walk on the white beach. Lunch is at the Rock, a restaurant built on a small rock in the sea at Michamvi, serving fresh seafood with views over the Indian Ocean. After time for a swim, you return to your hotel.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
09:00 – Pick-up.
10:00 – Jozani Forest and red colobus.
11:15 – Mangrove boardwalk.
12:00 – Seaweed cooperative at Paje.
13:30 – Lunch at the Rock.
15:30 – Beach time.
16:30 – Back at your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Kitesurfing lessons at Paje can be arranged.

INCLUDED: private vehicle and driver, licensed guide, forest entrance, cooperative visit, lunch, bottled water.
NOT INCLUDED: drinks, tips.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Will we see red colobus?
faq.answer: Almost always; the troops are habituated to visitors.

faq.question: Is lunch included?
faq.answer: Yes, at the Rock; drinks are extra.

faq.question: How do we reach the Rock?
faq.answer: On foot at low tide or by a short boat ride at high tide.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Largely; the forest trails are flat.

faq.question: Can we combine it with Stone Town?
Will we be taken to shops?
faq.answer: The cooperative sells products, with no obligation to buy.

faq.question: Is Zanzibar safe?
faq.answer: Yes; dress respectfully away from the beaches.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Light clothes, closed shoes for the forest, swimwear and sun protection.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: June to October and December to February.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is customary on safari in Tanzania: guides, drivers and camp staff appreciate a tip if you were happy with their service, but it is always your choice. Your guide can suggest typical amounts.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
